svg.aria-label: Left: each fixed τ is followed by a fresh fit of A and b. Each SSE profile is shifted by its own minimum to compare its shape. Right: three fixed-τ curves use only observations from 0–3 s; curves outside the shaded interval are extrapolations. These profiles allow an unrestricted b, including negative extrapolated plateaus.
